Third-party libraries, committed so the site has no runtime CDN dependency.

- pdfjs/ - PDF.js 3.11.174 (legacy build), Apache-2.0, https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
- page-flip/ - StPageFlip 2.0.7, MIT, https://github.com/Nodlik/StPageFlip

Used by the shop flipbook reader (app/Views/Shop/orders/flipbook.php).
